_about: Sea step 6 sea chart (core/sea/sea_chart.gd, game/sea_chart_window.gd; director "c": fog of war AND squares completed by exploring their islands, charts reveal secrets). square: metres a chart square is a side (the sea's 18 km = 9 x 9 squares, A1..I9; a region = 3 x 3 squares). fog_cell: metres a fog cell is a side; reveal: metres round the player the fog clears. An island is explored within explore_share x its radius + explore_extra m of its middle. A square with no island is complete when open_sea_share of its fog is cleared. pins: how many marks a player may set (pin_reach m to remove one). secrets: charts that show a hidden place while their item (data/fantasy/gear.json kind sea_chart) is in the bag: at = sea position, kind salvage / place; their names and lines in data/sea/writing/chart.txt. ALL NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS.
